findings.finding: ast.Constant stores decimal literals as binary floats; evaluate reconstructs str(node.value) rather than source token, so exact rational/Decimal paths can silently change source decimals.
findings.current_status: REPAIRED; source-bound lexical token retained and unattached float exact modes rejected
findings.consequence: Before repair, an advertised exact rational enclosure can fail to enclose the actual source-literal result.
findings.recommendation: Retain exact numeric token text under bounded syntax, or reject decimal constants whose exact source spelling was lost.

findings.finding: Parser eager-validation evaluates at x=1 regardless of the source data domain.
findings.current_status: REPAIRED; syntax validation independent of artificial numerical input
findings.consequence: Before repair, valid supported expressions whose only singularity is x=1 return UNKNOWN even when all observations avoid that singularity.
findings.recommendation: Perform syntax/type/name validation independently of numerical domain; evaluate at actual row inputs under explicit domain guards.

findings.finding: Interval overlap is necessary for compatibility with a conservative enclosure, but does not establish that one common parameter assignment attains the reported RSS. Dependency widening can create false apparent compatibility.
findings.recommendation: Use NOT_REFUTED_BY_ENCLOSURE terminology and preserve conditional nearest-rounding assumption.

findings.finding: Parameter standard-deviation table entries are parsed but neither sign-validated nor independently reproduced. The successful status concerns residual statistics only.
findings.recommendation: Declare standard-deviation inference unsupported; reject negative values as malformed and do not treat reported parameter standard deviations as bounds.
